title: ERP sync failing for Acme warehouse #3
description: Inventory sync between the ERP and WMS for warehouse #3 has been failing since yesterday afternoon. Stock counts are diverging and orders are being incorrectly allocated.

title: Unable to generate monthly financial report
description: The monthly P&L report fails to generate with error: 'Journal entry mismatch detected'. This is blocking month-end closing for Delta Trade.

title: CRM email integration not syncing
description: Outlook emails sent to clients are not being logged in CRM Pro. The OAuth token may have expired. Affects the entire sales team at TechWave.

title: Request: Add custom field to lead form
description: TechWave wants to add a 'Lead Source Category' dropdown to the CRM lead capture form with 8 custom options.

title: Payroll calculation error for overtime hours
description: HR & Payroll is computing overtime at 1x instead of 2x for employees tagged under the 'Production' department. Affects 45 employees in the June payroll.

title: Inventory barcode scanner not recognized on mobile
description: The NHQ Mobile Suite barcode scanner module fails to initialize on Android 14 devices. Works fine on Android 12 and 13.

title: Data import from legacy system failing
description: Delta Trade's legacy system CSV export has a different date format (DD/MM/YYYY) but the import wizard expects MM/DD/YYYY. Bulk import of 50,000 records is failing.

title: Dashboard showing stale data after refresh
description: The Analytics Engine dashboard shows data that is 2 hours old even after a manual refresh. Cache invalidation may not be working correctly.

title: Leave approval workflow stuck
description: Leave requests submitted by employees are not reaching their line managers for approval. The workflow appears to be stuck at the 'Pending Approval' stage indefinitely.

title: API rate limit errors in ERP connector
description: NHQ Connect is hitting rate limits on the third-party logistics API (ShipBD). Orders are queuing up and shipment confirmations are delayed by 3-4 hours.

title: User cannot reset password
description: Multiple users at Acme Corporation are reporting they do not receive the password reset email. The issue seems to affect @acmecorp.com addresses only.

title: Purchase order PDF not generating
description: When clicking 'Generate PDF' on a Purchase Order, the system shows a blank page and the PDF download never initiates. Affects all users.

title: Analytics report export to Excel failing
description: Exporting any report to Excel from the Analytics Engine results in a corrupted .xlsx file that cannot be opened. PDF export works fine.

title: Mobile app crashes on product scan
description: Scanning a product barcode in the receiving screen causes the NHQ Mobile Suite app to crash immediately on iOS 17.4.

title: Two-factor authentication setup guide request
description: TechWave's IT team wants detailed documentation on setting up 2FA for all employee accounts in the CRM Pro portal.

title: Database corruption after failed migration
description: A failed database migration script left the production database in an inconsistent state. Several transactions are stuck and data integrity is at risk for Acme Corp.
